title: First Steps in the Void taken from the Central Nexus board: 1,000 cr once, 15 carbon ore mined at Acubens Belt, handed in at Central Nexus
note: For a pilot that does not hold First Steps in the Void: the Central Nexus board offers it (mine 15 carbon ore, 1,000 cr once) to every pilot that has not done it; voidborn-first-steps serves only a pilot that already holds it. Test by hand, one trader, 08:46 to 08:57 UTC: accepted at Central Nexus, 15 carbon mined at Acubens Belt in about 5 minutes, handed in at Central Nexus: RESULT +922 cr after fuel in 12 minutes (data/routes/runs.jsonl). It opens the next link, Network Expansion (1,500 cr, route voidborn-network-expansion). Acubens Belt held 76 carbon ore at 08:12 and 182 at 08:46 UTC with this test mining 15 there (data/scouting/acubens.json): it regains on the order of 100 units an hour or more; max_ships 3 (45 units at a time) beside the 2 of voidborn-first-steps. When runs end with the objectives not done, the field is the limit: lower max_ships. Stamped 2026-11-16 08:58 UTC.
